muted.$description: Muted / secondary text (light) — darkened from #7d7a75 to clear WCAG-AA 4.5:1 not just on --color-bg but on the lightest tinted surfaces it lands on (accent-tint banners ~#eaedea, composer surface ~#e5e3e1) (FR-K2, Phase-4 a11y)

accent.$description: Primary accent / interactive (light) — coral, darkened from #d87758 (via #a75c44) so accent text clears WCAG-AA 4.5:1 on its own --color-accent-light tint (~#ede0da — the soft feedback banner / badge surface), not just on --color-bg; white-on-accent also clears (FR-K2, Phase-4 a11y)

accent-light.$description: Accent tint — derived at runtime via color-mix

success.$description: Success / positive state (light) — darkened from #2f8f5b so white-on-success and success-on-bg text both clear WCAG-AA 4.5:1 (FR-K2, Phase-4 a11y)

warning.$description: Warning / caution (light) — promoted from inline .badge-warning to a token (frozen v20)
